title: Google launches Gemini avatars #googlegemini #aiavatars #digitalcloning
description:
Google launched Gemini avatars in the Gemini app, giving Pro and Ultra users a fast way to create a talking digital clone from a single face and voice capture. The feature turns a short 3D biometric scan into an avatar that can generate videos of you speaking any typed script in multiple languages.

The core shift is friction reduction: no camera setup, no filming, and no manual editing. Google maps facial structure, movement, and voice, then lets users trigger avatar videos through text, making AI-generated personal content far easier to produce at scale.

That matters for creators, marketers, educators, and businesses building repeatable video workflows. It also highlights the growing competition around AI identity tools, where convenience, realism, and trust around face-and-voice data storage are becoming key product differentiators.

Google says the avatar data is stored in the user’s account, limited to users 18+, and can be deleted at any time, though already published videos remain online. The script also references Phygital+ as an all-in-one AI creative studio for image generation, video editing, and 3D production.
